mathematical_results.absolute_continuity: For independent absolutely continuous coordinates and any nonzero symmetric A, X^TAX is absolutely continuous by a proof entirely in original coordinates: condition on one coordinate; use a nonconstant quadratic if a diagonal entry is nonzero, otherwise choose an off-diagonal entry and note the random affine slope has an absolutely continuous law and is nonzero almost surely.
mathematical_results.dyadic_regularity_ladder: For K_r(x)=(r-|x|)_+/r^2 and every finite positive measure mu, D_infinity(mu)=sup_{k>=0}||K_{2^-k}*mu||_infinity. Moreover mu has a C_0 density iff the dyadic triangular profiles are Cauchy in L^infinity. Summable consecutive defects give an explicit uniform convergence tail bound.
mathematical_results.strict_height_continuity_separation: The density 1_[0,1] has height 1 but no continuous representative; its triangular profiles at r and r/2 differ by at least 1/8 at y=r/2 for r<=1/2.
mathematical_results.no_uniform_continuity_modulus: Using the completed account02/B15 verified fixed-A=I_3 phase-aligned family, with r_m=pi/s_m, ||K_{r_m}*p_m-p_m||_infinity has liminf at least [27/(64*297)](1-4/pi^2)>8.44e-4 even though p_m are smooth, compactly supported and ||p_m||_infinity<=1/2. Hence no source-uniform continuity/desmoothing modulus exists. For every 0<alpha<=1, [p_m]_{C^{0,alpha}} grows at least a positive constant times s_m^alpha.
mathematical_results.soft_bank_regularity: If completed physical majority-sheet submeasures obey mu_S^+<=C_S dx, weights a_S define R=sum a_S 1_GS, and alpha_delta/beta_delta are output restrictions to R>=delta/R<delta, then alpha_delta<=D_delta dx with D_delta=delta^-1 sum a_S C_S. Its width-2r box profile is D_delta/r-Lipschitz locally and its normalized tent profile has derivative Lipschitz constant <=4D_delta/r^2. The residual satisfies H_r^beta(y)>=[H_r^mu(y)-(H_r^mu(y-h)+H_r^mu(y+h))/2-2D_delta h^2/r^2]_+.
mathematical_results.partner_actual_inequality: Account02/B15 gives C_S<=pi sqrt(2)/kappa_S for invertible indefinite original-coordinate physical triples. With a_S=kappa_S/sum kappa and average kappa >= c s_3(A), s_3(A)D_delta<=pi sqrt(2)/(c delta), so the high-majority part has explicit target-normalized box-Lipschitz and tent-C1,1 budgets.
